How the basket optimiser works

Every basket is checked against every verified supplier before we show you a total.

Search

Find the product

Search matches a single canonical product, not a supplier's own naming — so typos and inconsistent listings never break comparison.

Compare

See the true total

We sort by product cost plus delivery, not headline price — a free-delivery £24 offer can beat a £21 offer with a delivery charge attached.

Optimise

Fewer suppliers, lower cost

When splitting a basket across fewer suppliers saves you a delivery charge, we surface it — and explain exactly why.

ⓘ

Why isn't Botox priced here? Botulinum toxin and other prescription-only medicines can't be advertised or priced to the public under MHRA and ASA rules. Verified prescribers will be able to request this pricing directly once professional verification is complete.
